candidates.snippet: An alleged trespasser was stopped by private security at a Malibu property belonging to former Vice President Kamala Harris on Friday night, according to local authorities and a Harris spokesperson. https://t.co/KeVBgEfo4Z

At a museum in eastern France, two men disguised with wigs used a sledgehammer and a hammer to smash a display case and make off with a 2,500-year-old gold necklace. The heist took under four minutes. https://t.co/7SCmCtCxln
The CEO of Ryanair on Thursday disputed that a passenger injured during a flight on one of its planes in July was partly sucked out a broken window. https://t.co/ZAdUIw6vQs
